title: Lesson 19: Advanced OmniScript Properties
description: Configure advanced properties for Omniscripts (Mult-language, Save Options, Knowledge Articles, Messaging Framework, etc.).

questions.question: A global bank needs its loan OmniScript in English and Spanish. What do you configure?
questions.explanation: Multi-language renders translated labels per locale.

questions.question: Users must save a partially completed application and resume later. Which property?
An OmniScript must send a confirmation SMS after submission. Which capability?
questions.explanation: Messaging Framework sends SMS/email from OmniScript actions.
